description: The core's fixed text (spec/presentation-contract-v0.md sections 6.1, 6.2 and 8): one banner line per verification state, the refusal, the unable-to-verify lines, the check lists' headings and lines, and the extension rows. A viewer draws exactly these words; no module, wording pack or bundle supplies them.

banner.description: Every check the bundle calls for ran here and passed.
No check failed, but some were not run, and the page draws a not-checked list.
banner.line: None of the bundle's checks failed, but some were not run: see "Not checked on this page" below

banner.description: No check failed, but some were not run, and the page draws no not-checked list (for example, nothing is signed).
banner.line: None of the bundle's checks failed, but some were not run

banner.description: A check failed and the records are still shown.
banner.line: ✗ A check failed: do not rely on this page

banner.description: A check failed and the page's own checks refuse the records; the refusal line follows.
banner.line: ✗ This bundle did not verify: do not rely on it

banner.description: This runtime could not run the checks at all.
banner.line: Couldn't check this page here: check it with a full verifier

refusal: This bundle did not verify. Its records, rows and payloads are not shown; the verification page below lists which checks failed.

unable.reason: This viewer cannot compute the SHA-256 digests the checks need, so nothing was checked and no records are shown. This is not a failed check: the file may well be valid.
unable.no_command: To check this file, open it from a secure (https) page, or check it with a verifier outside this viewer.

lines.words: Each record's contents against the capsule ID it was sealed with.
Each record's required fields, effects, verdict, chain parent and assurance claims.
lines.technical_name: required fields, effect consistency, verdict conflict, chain parent, assurance claims

lines.words: That every record the root cites, to the stated depth, is in this file or listed as missing.
That no record is missing from the stretch of the log this file covers.
That each record bound to a log position sits at that position.
The signature on the log's checkpoint, and the fields it signs.
Each disclosed value against the digest its record committed to.
Each countersignature's signature, over this bundle's digest, under the key it names.
Each bundle this file composes, and the digest over the composition.
The producer signature on the records this page cites as signers, each marked beside it as verified or not. Not the signature on every record.
The producer signature on every record.
Each witness receipt this file carries.
A countersignature of a type this page does not check.
The receipt carried with a countersignature.

check_lists.checkpoint_not_checked_note: This page could not check it, so the range and membership checks rest on a checkpoint the producer asserted.
check_lists.full_verifier: To run these checks, verify the bundle with a full verifier.
check_lists.scope: None of these checks says who produced the records, or that this file is the most recent copy.

extension_rows.shown_covered: Shown by the page's module; covered by the file's fingerprint
extension_rows.shown_not_covered: Shown by the page's module; not covered by the file's fingerprint
extension_rows.read_by_page_covered: Read by this page itself; covered by the file's fingerprint
extension_rows.read_by_page_not_covered: Read by this page itself; not covered by the file's fingerprint
extension_rows.not_interpreted_covered: Covered by the file's fingerprint; not interpreted by this page's checks
extension_rows.not_interpreted_not_covered: Not covered by the file's fingerprint; not interpreted by this page's checks
